manifest.intervention: Replace Connectome.step output with eight unchanged upstream observations followed by eight zeros. No recurrence, gain, centering, or extra features.

training.checkpointSelection: Strict improvement on original four validation courses only

manifest.policy: Run all three training seeds for exactly 80 generations before evaluating any test course. Report every run. No hyperparameter or checkpoint selection using tests.
manifest.comparison: Original published connectome checkpoints, same three training seeds and same episode budget. Original training is not rerun; inference is reevaluated locally.
